moduleArDiscoverDesc: Discover points in a 360° image or camera view with the laser.
presetArDiscover_cameraDesc: Points in the real camera view on site
arDiscoverStartBody: Point your phone at your surroundings. Hold the laser on a point to discover it.
arDiscoverMotionDenied: Motion sensor not available – drag to look around.
arDiscoverCameraError: The camera is not available. You can still continue.
arDiscoverLoadError: The view could not be started. You can still continue.
arDiscoverAimHint: Hold the laser on a point
arDiscoverMapLabel: Area for placing points. Clicking adds a point, arrow keys move the selected point.
arDiscoverMapHint: Click the area to place a point. Drag to move it, arrow keys fine-tune (Shift = larger steps).
arDiscoverLiveHint: Drag the image until the center points at the spot you want, then place the point.
arDiscoverReferenceHint: A 360° photo of the location helps with placing. Visitors see their camera view on site.
arDiscoverRequireAll: Continue only after all points are discovered
arDiscoverRequireAllHint: Otherwise visitors can continue at any time.
arDiscoverIntroPlaceholderCamera: Stand in front of the gate and point your phone at the entrance.
arDiscoverCameraIntroHint: With a camera background the introduction describes the start view – points are placed relative to it.
moduleModel3dDesc: Place a 3D model in the camera view or a 360° image.
presetModel3d_cameraDesc: The model stands in the live camera view on site
presetModel3d_panoramaDesc: The model stands in a surround photo
model3dStartBody: Point your phone at your surroundings. The model stands right in front of you. Swipe across it to turn it.
model3dLoadError: The 3D model could not be loaded. You can still continue.
model3dDragHint: Drag to look around, drag the model to turn it
model3dSwipeHint: Swipe across the model to turn it
model3dAimHint: Hold the laser on an info point
adminModelTooLarge: The 3D model is too large (max. 15 MB).
adminModelInvalid: Please choose a valid GLB file.
model3dEditorModelHint: A GLB file. The fewer triangles and the smaller the textures, the smoother it runs on phones.
model3dPreviewHint: Drag the image to look around. This is how visitors see the model.
model3dPreviewEmpty: Choose a 3D model to set it up here.
model3dPlaceHintAdd: Tap the spot on the model where the info point should sit.
model3dPlaceHintMove: Tap the new spot on the model.
model3dPlaceMiss: That was beside the model. Tap directly on the model.
model3dHeavy: This model is heavy and may stutter on older phones. Better: under 300,000 triangles and textures up to 4096 px.
model3dTopViewLabel: Top view: drag the model to set direction and distance. Arrow keys move it (left/right: direction, up/down: distance).
model3dTopViewHint: Drag the square to where the model should stand. The start view is at the top.
model3dUserRotateHint: By swiping across the model or with two buttons.
model3dPointsHint: Visitors open them with the laser or by tapping.
model3dMax: At most {max} info points per module.
model3dErrorRange: Please enter a value between {min} and {max}.
model3dPlacementHint: Drag the model in the top view or set the values precisely.
model3dYawHint: 0° = straight ahead in the start view, positive = to the right.
model3dPointsEmpty: Optional: place info points right on the model. Visitors discover them with the laser.
model3dPreviewLoadError: The model could not be loaded. Is the GLB file okay?
